repository.scope: Working-tree implementation and targeted checks; this is not whole-release certification.

checks.buildWarning: sync-engine has both static and dynamic imports; it is not moved to a separate chunk

checks.command: npm run test -- src/tests/assistant-error-codes.test.ts src/tests/ai-feedback-client.test.ts src/tests/assistant-mobile-reach.test.ts src/tests/sync-failure-handling.test.ts src/tests/local-reports-daily-closing.test.ts src/tests/financial-aggregation-service.test.ts

verifiedBehaviors: Provider-authored sales amounts and completion claims cannot replace server-composed evidence replies.
A successful unrelated lookup or a status-only trace does not validate provider prose.
Large integer paise remain exact; null amounts are unavailable and negative stock keeps its sign.
Real catalogue lookups distinguish stock base units from price rate units.
Real customer lookups use the ledger-derived balance instead of a stale cached customer amount.
Staff product detail results omit costs before they reach the provider.
Recent ledger entries omit free-form notes and retain dates, amounts and reversal information.
Named report ranges resolve to explicit dates in the configured shop timezone.
A provider failure after a successful read preserves the available verified answer.
Oversized results use valid JSON with a bounded server summary; unencodable results produce error traces.
Two confirmations forced to read the same pending plan still execute one write handler only.
Confirmation and rejection use competing atomic claims; another tenant cannot consume the plan.
Current owner-PIN risk and business-type availability are enforced again at execution.
A timed-out write can finish later without making the plan replayable; later steps are skipped.
Unencodable client-target output is reported as undelivered rather than applied.
limitations: The provider in the new runtime tests is scripted. These checks do not estimate accuracy on real merchant traffic or accents.
The agent can still select an irrelevant tool, misunderstand intent, or omit part of a request. Write proposals still require human review.
The new concurrency scenarios ran on an isolated SQLite database; this report does not claim that those new scenarios were rerun on PostgreSQL.
Feedback proportions need independently labelled samples to establish population false-accept and false-reject rates.
No physical-device certification, credentialed GSP submission, native channel production traffic, or deployed release certification was established by this pass.
The last whole-release certification remains failed because repository content changed during its run.
